title: Joe Venuti and Jerry Colonna
summary: He describes Venuti as a crazy but wonderful fiddler on radio and mentions friend Jerry Colonna sitting in at the Famous Door.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: I worked with, uh, Joe Venuti. Yeah. Oh, you know Joe?
I never knew him. I was always hearing stories about Joe.
Now, that is a crazy son of a gun. Yeah. I don't want to curse over this one.
Well, that's, if you forget yourself, we'll erase it.

Yeah. Uh, Joe's a crazy guy, buddy. He's a wonderful fiddle player, man. Oh, yeah. And he's good. You put him on a radio with you, man, he make you laugh. You... Yeah. I went, uh, with him, uh, on a radio program one night. I couldn't stop laughing. The guy's so crazy. But you see, Joe Venuti should have been a big star, no kidding. Because he's a terrific fiddle player, boy. And he's funny. Well, him and Jerry Colonna are very good friends, you know? Yeah. And Jerry, I don't know, what happened to Jerry? I don't know, I have no idea.
He just dropped out of there. He used to come sit in at the famous door.
